item.text:
It provides shop-order helpers: totals, discount application, average pricing, and formatted order text.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` uses `i <= items.length`; the final iteration reads `items[items.length]` (undefined), causing a `TypeError`. Use `i < items.length`.
- Consequently, `averageItemPrice` and `formatOrder` also crash whenever they calculate a total.
- `averageItemPrice` divides an order total (`price × qty`) by number of item lines, so it is not an average item/unit price when quantities exceed 1. It also returns `NaN` for an empty list.
